segments.dn25:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
segments.dn25:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena nigrodho paribbājako udumbarikāya paribbājakārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ tiṃsamattehi paribbājakasatehi.
segments.dn25:1.4: Atha kho sandhāno gahapati divā divassa [divādivasseva (sī. syā. pī.)] rājagahā nikkhami bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
segments.dn25:1.10: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yena udumbarikāya paribbājakārāmo, yena nigrodho paribbājako tenupasaṅkameyya”nti.
segments.dn25:1.11: Atha kho sandhāno gahapati yena udumbarikāya paribbājakārāmo, tenupasaṅkami. 50.
segments.dn25:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena nigrodho paribbājako mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti unnādiniyā uccāsaddamahāsaddāya anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentiyā.
segments.dn25:2.2: Seyyathidaṃ – rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā. 51.
segments.dn25:3.1: Addasā kho nigrodho paribbājako sandhānaṃ gahapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.dn25:3.4: Ayaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako āgacchati sandhāno gahapati.
segments.dn25:3.5: Yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā rājagahe paṭivasanti, ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro sandhāno gahapati.
segments.dn25:3.6: Appasaddakāmā kho panete āyasmanto appasaddavinītā, appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino.
segments.dn25:3.7: Appeva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti.
segments.dn25:3.8: Evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ. 52.
segments.dn25:4.1: Atha kho sandhāno gahapati yena nigrodho paribbājako tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā nigrodhena paribbājakena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.dn25:4.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sandhāno gahapati nigrodhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn25:4.3: “aññathā kho ime bhonto aññatitthiyā paribbājakā saṅgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
segments.dn25:4.5: Aññathā kho [ca (sī. pī.)] pana so bhagavā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppānī”ti. 53.
segments.dn25:5.1: Evaṃ vutte nigrodho paribbājako sandhānaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn25:5.2: “yagghe gahapati, jāneyyāsi, kena samaṇo gotamo saddhiṃ sallapati, kena sākacchaṃ samāpajjati, kena paññāveyyattiyaṃ samāpajjati?
segments.dn25:5.3: Suññāgārahatā samaṇassa gotamassa paññā aparisāvacaro samaṇo gotamo nālaṃ sallāpāya.
segments.dn25:5.5: Seyyathāpi nāma gokāṇā pariyantacārinī antamantāneva sevati.
segments.dn25:5.10: Iṅgha, gahapati, samaṇo gotamo imaṃ parisaṃ āgaccheyya, ekapañheneva naṃ saṃsādeyyāma [saṃhareyyāma (ka.)], tucchakumbhīva naṃ maññe orodheyyāmā”ti. 54.
segments.dn25:6.1: Assosi kho bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya sandhānassa gahapatissa nigrodhena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
segments.dn25:6.2: Atha kho bhagavā gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohitvā yena sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkami.
segments.dn25:6.3: Addasā kho nigrodho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkamantaṃ.
segments.dn25:6.5: “appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddamakattha, ayaṃ samaṇo gotamo sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkamati.
segments.dn25:6.6: Appasaddakāmo kho pana so āyasmā, appasaddassa vaṇṇavādī.
segments.dn25:6.7: Appeva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyya.
segments.dn25:6.8: Sace samaṇo gotamo imaṃ parisaṃ āgaccheyya, imaṃ taṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyāma –
segments.dn25:6.9: ‘ko nāma so, bhante, bhagavato dhammo, yena bhagavā sāvake vineti, yena bhagavatā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariya’nti?
segments.dn25:6.10: Evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.dn25:7.0: Tapojigucchāvādo 55. Atha kho bhagavā yena nigrodho paribbājako tenupasaṅkami.
segments.dn25:7.2: Atha kho nigrodho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn25:7.3: “etu kho, bhante, bhagavā, svāgataṃ, bhante, bhagavato.
segments.dn25:7.4: Cirassaṃ kho, bhante, bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya.
segments.dn25:7.7: Nigrodhopi kho paribbājako aññataraṃ nīcāsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn25:7.8: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nigrodhaṃ paribbājakaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.dn25:7.9: “kāya nuttha, nigrodha, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā”ti?
segments.dn25:7.10: Evaṃ vutte, nigrodho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca,
segments.dn25:7.11: “idha mayaṃ, bhante, addasāma bhagavantaṃ sumāgadhāya tīre moranivāpe abbhokāse caṅkamantaṃ, disvāna evaṃ avocumhā –
segments.dn25:7.12: ‘sace samaṇo gotamo imaṃ parisaṃ āgaccheyya, imaṃ taṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyāma –
segments.dn25:7.13: ko nāma so, bhante, bhagavato dhammo, yena bhagavā sāvake vineti, yena bhagavatā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariya’nti?
segments.dn25:7.14: Ayaṃ kho no, bhante, antarākathā vippakatā; atha bhagavā anuppatto”ti. 56.
segments.dn25:7.15: “Dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, nigrodha, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrāyogena aññatrācariyakena, yenāhaṃ sāvake vinemi, yena mayā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariyaṃ.
segments.dn25:7.16: Iṅgha tvaṃ maṃ, nigrodha, sake ācariyake adhijegucche pañhaṃ puccha –
segments.dn25:7.17: ‘kathaṃ santā nu kho, bhante, tapojigucchā paripuṇṇā hoti, kathaṃ aparipuṇṇā’ti?
segments.dn25:7.18: Evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā ahesuṃ –
segments.dn25:7.19: “acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, samaṇassa gotamassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāma sakavādaṃ ṭhapessati, paravādena pavāressatī”ti. 57.
segments.dn25:8.1: Atha kho nigrodho paribbājako te paribbājake appasadde katvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn25:8.2: “mayaṃ kho, bhante, tapojigucchāvādā [tarojigucchaṃsārodā (ka.)] tapojigucchāsārā tapojigucchāallīnā viharāma.
segments.dn25:8.3: Kathaṃ santā nu kho, bhante, tapojigucchā paripuṇṇā hoti, kathaṃ aparipuṇṇā”ti?
segments.dn25:8.4: “Idha, nigrodha, tapassī acelako hoti muttācāro, hatthāpalekhano [hatthāvalekhano (syā.)], na ehibhaddantiko, na tiṭṭhabhaddantiko, nābhihaṭaṃ, na uddissakataṃ, na nimantanaṃ sādiyati,
segments.dn25:8.5: so na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhāti, na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhāti, na eḷakamantaraṃ, na daṇḍamantaraṃ, na musalamantaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā, na pāyamānāya, na purisantaragatāya, na saṅkittīsu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ, na maṃsaṃ, na suraṃ, na merayaṃ, na thusodakaṃ pivati,
segments.dn25:8.6: so ekāgāriko vā hoti ekālopiko, dvāgāriko vā hoti dvālopiko, sattāgāriko vā hoti sattālopiko, ekissāpi dattiyā yāpeti, dvīhipi dattīhi yāpeti, sattahipi dattīhi yāpeti;
segments.dn25:8.7: ekāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti, dvīhikampi [dvāhikaṃpi (sī. syā.)] āhāraṃ āhāreti, sattāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti, iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikampi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
segments.dn25:8.8: So sākabhakkho vā hoti, sāmākabhakkho vā hoti, nīvārabhakkho vā hoti, daddulabhakkho vā hoti, haṭabhakkho vā hoti, kaṇabhakkho vā hoti, ācāmabhakkho vā hoti, piññākabhakkho vā hoti, tiṇabhakkho vā hoti, gomayabhakkho vā hoti; vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
segments.dn25:8.9: So sāṇānipi dhāreti, masāṇānipi dhāreti, chavadussānipi dhāreti, paṃsukūlānipi dhāreti, tirīṭānipi dhāreti, ajinampi dhāreti, ajinakkhipampi dhāreti, kusacīrampi dhāreti, vākacīrampi dhāreti, phalakacīrampi dhāreti, kesakambalampi dhāreti, vāḷakambalampi dhāreti, ulūkapakkhampi dhāreti,
segments.dn25:8.23: yadi evaṃ sante tapojigucchā paripuṇṇā vā hoti aparipuṇṇā vā”ti?
segments.dn25:8.24: “Addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante tapojigucchā paripuṇṇā hoti, no aparipuṇṇā”ti.
segments.dn25:8.25: “Evaṃ paripuṇṇāyapi kho ahaṃ, nigrodha, tapojigucchāya anekavihite upakkilese vadāmī”ti.
segments.dn25:9.1: “Yathā kathaṃ pana, bhante, bhagavā evaṃ paripuṇṇāya tapojigucchāya anekavihite upakkilese vadatī”ti?
segments.dn25:9.2: “Idha, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.dn25:9.3: Yampi, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
segments.dn25:9.4: Ayampi kho, nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
segments.dn25:9.5: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā attānukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
segments.dn25:9.6: Yampi, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā attānukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
segments.dn25:9.7: Ayampi kho, nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
segments.dn25:9.8: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā majjati mucchati pamādamāpajjati [madamāpajjati (syā.)].
segments.dn25:9.9: Yampi, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā majjati mucchati pamādamāpajjati.
segments.dn25:9.10: Ayampi kho, nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti. 59.

segments.dn25:10.12: So yañca [yaṃ hi (sī. pī.)] khvassa nakkhamati, taṃ sāpekkho pajahati.
segments.dn25:10.13: Yaṃ panassa khamati, taṃ gadhito [gathito (sī. pī.)] mucchito ajjhāpanno anādīnavadassāvī anissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati…pe…

segments.dn25:11.3: Seyyathidaṃ – mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phaḷubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījameva pañcamaṃ, asanivicakkaṃ dantakūṭaṃ, samaṇappavādenā’ti…pe…
segments.dn25:11.4: ayampi kho, nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.
segments.dn25:11.5: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī passati aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā kulesu sakkariyamānaṃ garukariyamānaṃ māniyamānaṃ pūjiyamānaṃ.
segments.dn25:11.7: ‘imañhi nāma sambahulājīvaṃ kulesu sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti.
segments.dn25:11.8: Maṃ pana tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ kulesu na sakkaronti na garuṃ karonti na mānenti na pūjentī’ti, iti so issāmacchariyaṃ kulesu uppādetā hoti…pe…

segments.dn25:11.16: So ‘khamati te ida’nti puṭṭho samāno akkhamamānaṃ āha – ‘khamatī’ti.

segments.dn25:12.17: “Addhā kho ime, bhante, tapojigucchā [tapojigucchāya (?)] upakkilesā [upakkilesā hoti (ka.)], no anupakkilesā.
segments.dn25:12.18: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, bhante, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco tapassī sabbeheva imehi upakkilesehi samannāgato assa;
segments.dn25:13.1: “Idha, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā na attamano hoti na paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.

segments.dn25:14.1: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī passati aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā kulesu sakkariyamānaṃ garu kariyamānaṃ māniyamānaṃ pūjiyamānaṃ.
segments.dn25:14.3: ‘imañhi nāma sambahulājīvaṃ kulesu sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti.
segments.dn25:14.4: Maṃ pana tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ kulesu na sakkaronti na garuṃ karonti na mānenti na pūjentī’ti, iti so issāmacchariyaṃ kulesu nuppādetā hoti…pe…
segments.dn25:14.5: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti. 68.
segments.dn25:14.6: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī na āpāthakanisādī hoti…pe…
segments.dn25:14.7: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
segments.dn25:14.8: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī na attānaṃ adassayamāno kulesu carati –
segments.dn25:14.10: evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
segments.dn25:14.11: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī na kañcideva paṭicchannaṃ sevati, so –
segments.dn25:14.12: ‘khamati te ida’nti puṭṭho samāno akkhamamānaṃ āha –
segments.dn25:14.16: Iti so sampajānamusā na bhāsitā hoti…pe…

segments.dn25:15.1: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā dhammaṃ desentassa santaṃyeva pariyāyaṃ anuññeyyaṃ anujānāti…pe…

segments.dn25:15.4: Yampi, nigrodha, tapassī akkodhano hoti anupanāhī evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.
segments.dn25:15.5: “Puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī amakkhī hoti apaḷāsī…pe…
segments.dn25:15.9: na pāpiccho hoti na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato…
segments.dn25:15.10: na micchādiṭṭhiko hoti na antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato…
segments.dn25:15.11: na sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti na ādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī.
segments.dn25:15.12: Yampi, nigrodha, tapassī na sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti na ādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī.
segments.dn25:15.13: Evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hoti.

segments.dn25:15.17: “Na kho, nigrodha, ettāvatā tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca;
segments.dn25:16.1: “Kittāvatā pana, bhante, tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca?
segments.dn25:16.2: Sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā tapojigucchāya aggaññeva pāpetu, sāraññeva pāpetū”ti.
segments.dn25:16.5: Idha, nigrodha, tapassī na pāṇaṃ atipāteti [atipāpeti (ka. sī. pī. ka.)], na pāṇaṃ atipātayati, na pāṇamatipātayato samanuñño hoti.
segments.dn25:16.6: Na adinnaṃ ādiyati, na adinnaṃ ādiyāpeti, na adinnaṃ ādiyato samanuñño hoti.
segments.dn25:16.7: Na musā bhaṇati, na musā bhaṇāpeti, na musā bhaṇato samanuñño hoti.
segments.dn25:16.8: Na bhāvitamāsīsati [na bhāvitamāsiṃ sati (sī. syā. pī.)], na bhāvitamāsīsāpeti, na bhāvitamāsīsato samanuñño hoti.
segments.dn25:16.9: Evaṃ kho, nigrodha, tapassī cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti.
segments.dn25:16.10: “Yato kho, nigrodha, tapassī cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto hoti, aduṃ cassa hoti tapassitāya.
segments.dn25:16.12: So vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
segments.dn25:16.13: So pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātappaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
segments.dn25:16.14: So abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
segments.dn25:16.15: Byāpādappadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī, byāpādappadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
segments.dn25:16.16: Thinamiddhaṃ [thīnamiddhaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] pahāya vigatathinamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno, thinamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
segments.dn25:16.17: Uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto, uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
segments.dn25:16.18: Vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti. 71.
segments.dn25:17.1: “So ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
segments.dn25:17.2: mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. Tathā dutiyaṃ. Tathā tatiyaṃ. Tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
segments.dn25:17.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. Tathā dutiyaṃ. Tathā tatiyaṃ. Tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.

segments.dn25:18.13: So anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati seyyathidaṃ – ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattālīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe – ‘amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. segments.dn25:19.12: So dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāti – ‘ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. Te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. Ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. Te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti. Iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.

segments.dn25:19.15: “Addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante tapojigucchā parisuddhā hoti no aparisuddhā, aggappattā ca sārappattā cā”ti. 74.
segments.dn25:19.16: “Ettāvatā kho, nigrodha, tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca.
segments.dn25:19.17: Iti kho, nigrodha [iti nigrodha (syā.)], yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ avacāsi –
segments.dn25:19.18: ‘ko nāma so, bhante, bhagavato dhammo, yena bhagavā sāvake vineti, yena bhagavatā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariya’nti.
segments.dn25:19.19: Iti kho taṃ, nigrodha, ṭhānaṃ uttaritarañca paṇītatarañca, yenāhaṃ sāvake vinemi, yena mayā sāvakā vinītā assāsappattā paṭijānanti ajjhāsayaṃ ādibrahmacariya”nti.
segments.dn25:19.20: Evaṃ vutte, te paribbājakā unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā ahesuṃ –
segments.dn25:19.21: “ettha mayaṃ anassāma sācariyakā, na mayaṃ ito bhiyyo uttaritaraṃ pajānāmā”ti.
segments.dn25:20.2: “aññadatthu kho dānime aññatitthiyā paribbājakā bhagavato bhāsitaṃ sussūsanti, sotaṃ odahanti, aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpentī”ti.
segments.dn25:20.4: “iti kho, bhante nigrodha, yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ avacāsi –
segments.dn25:20.5: ‘yagghe, gahapati, jāneyyāsi, kena samaṇo gotamo saddhiṃ sallapati, kena sākacchaṃ samāpajjati, kena paññāveyyattiyaṃ samāpajjati,
segments.dn25:20.6: suññāgārahatā samaṇassa gotamassa paññā, aparisāvacaro samaṇo gotamo nālaṃ sallāpāya, so antamantāneva sevati;
segments.dn25:20.7: seyyathāpi nāma gokāṇā pariyantacārinī antamantāneva sevati.
segments.dn25:20.8: Evameva suññāgārahatā samaṇassa gotamassa paññā, aparisāvacaro samaṇo gotamo nālaṃ sallāpāya; so antamantāneva sevati;
segments.dn25:20.9: iṅgha, gahapati, samaṇo gotamo imaṃ parisaṃ āgaccheyya, ekapañheneva naṃ saṃsādeyyāma, tucchakumbhīva naṃ maññe orodheyyāmā’ti.
segments.dn25:20.10: Ayaṃ kho so, bhante, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho idhānuppatto, aparisāvacaraṃ pana naṃ karotha, gokāṇaṃ pariyantacāriniṃ karotha, ekapañheneva naṃ saṃsādetha, tucchakumbhīva naṃ orodhethā”ti.
segments.dn25:20.11: Evaṃ vutte, nigrodho paribbājako tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi. 76.
segments.dn25:21.1: Atha kho bhagavā nigrodhaṃ paribbājakaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā nigrodhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn25:21.2: “saccaṃ kira, nigrodha, bhāsitā te esā vācā”ti?
segments.dn25:21.3: “Saccaṃ, bhante, bhāsitā me esā vācā, yathābālena yathāmūḷhena yathāakusalenā”ti.
segments.dn25:21.5: Kinti te sutaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.dn25:21.6: ‘ye te ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, evaṃ su te bhagavanto saṃgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
segments.dn25:21.7: Seyyathidaṃ – rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ…pe… itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
segments.dn25:21.9: Udāhu, evaṃ su te bhagavanto araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni, seyyathāpāhaṃ etarahī’ti.
segments.dn25:21.10: “Sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante. Paribbājakānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.dn25:21.11: ‘ye te ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, na evaṃ su [nāssu (sī. pī.)] te bhagavanto saṃgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
segments.dn25:21.12: Seyyathidaṃ – rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ…pe… itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā,
segments.dn25:21.14: Evaṃ su te bhagavanto araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni, seyyathāpi bhagavā etarahī’”ti.
segments.dn25:21.15: “Tassa te, nigrodha, viññussa sato mahallakassa na etadahosi –
segments.dn25:21.16: ‘buddho so bhagavā bodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, danto so bhagavā damathāya dhammaṃ deseti, santo so bhagavā samathāya dhammaṃ deseti, tiṇṇo so bhagavā taraṇāya dhammaṃ deseti, parinibbuto so bhagavā parinibbānāya dhammaṃ desetī’”ti?
segments.dn25:22.1: Evaṃ vutte, nigrodho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn25:22.2: “accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yvāhaṃ evaṃ bhagavantaṃ avacāsiṃ.
segments.dn25:22.3: Tassa me, bhante, bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā”ti.
segments.dn25:22.4: “Taggha tvaṃ [taṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], nigrodha, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yo maṃ tvaṃ evaṃ avacāsi.
segments.dn25:22.5: Yato ca kho tvaṃ, nigrodha, accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi, taṃ te mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma.
segments.dn25:22.6: Vuddhi hesā, nigrodha, ariyassa vinaye, yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.dn25:22.7: Ahaṃ kho pana, nigrodha, evaṃ vadāmi –
segments.dn25:22.8: ‘Etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko, ahamanusāsāmi ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.dn25:22.9: Yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā [yathānusiṭṭhaṃ (?)] paṭipajjamāno, yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati sattavassāni.
segments.dn25:22.11: Etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko, ahamanusāsāmi ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.

segments.dn25:22.19: Etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko ahamanusāsāmi ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.dn25:22.20: Yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno, yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati satta māsāni.
segments.dn25:22.30: Etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko, ahamanusāsāmi ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.dn25:22.31: Yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno, yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati sattāhaṃ’.
segments.dn25:23.17: “Siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evamassa – ‘antevāsikamyatā no samaṇo gotamo evamāhā’ti. Na kho panetaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Yo eva vo [te (sī. syā.)] ācariyo, so eva vo ācariyo hotu. Siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evamassa – ‘uddesā no cāvetukāmo samaṇo gotamo evamāhā’ti. Na kho panetaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Yo eva vo uddeso so eva vo uddeso hotu. Siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evamassa – ‘ājīvā no cāvetukāmo samaṇo gotamo evamāhā’ti. Na kho panetaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Yo eva vo ājīvo, so eva vo ājīvo hotu. Siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evamassa – ‘ye no dhammā akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tesu patiṭṭhāpetukāmo samaṇo gotamo evamāhā’ti. Na kho panetaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Akusalā ceva vo te dhammā [vodhammā (ka.), te dhammā (syā.)] hontu akusalasaṅkhātā ca sācariyakānaṃ. Siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evamassa –
segments.dn25:23.18: ‘ye no dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tehi vivecetukāmo samaṇo gotamo evamāhā’ti.
segments.dn25:23.19: Na kho panetaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.dn25:23.20: Kusalā ceva vo te dhammā hontu kusalasaṅkhātā ca sācariyakānaṃ.
segments.dn25:23.21: Iti khvāhaṃ, nigrodha, neva antevāsikamyatā evaṃ vadāmi, napi uddesā cāvetukāmo evaṃ vadāmi, napi ājīvā cāvetukāmo evaṃ vadāmi, napi ye vo dhammā [napi ye kho dhammā (sī.), napi ye te dhammā (syā.), napi ye ca vo dhammā (ka.)] akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tesu patiṭṭhāpetukāmo evaṃ vadāmi, napi ye vo dhammā [napi ye kho dhammā (sī.), napi ye te dhammā (syā.), napi ye ca vo dhammā (ka.)] kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tehi vivecetukāmo evaṃ vadāmi.
segments.dn25:23.22: Santi ca kho, nigrodha, akusalā dhammā appahīnā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā [ponobhavikā (ka.)] sadarā [saddarā (pī. ka.), sadarathā (syā. ka.)] dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā, yesāhaṃ pahānāya dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.dn25:23.23: Yathāpaṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodānīyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti, paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañca diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā”ti. 79.
segments.dn25:24.1: Evaṃ vutte, te paribbājakā tuṇhībhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā nisīdiṃsu yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacittā.
segments.dn25:24.4: Yatra hi nāma ekassapi na evaṃ bhavissati –
segments.dn25:24.5: ‘handa mayaṃ aññāṇatthampi samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ carāma, kiṃ karissati sattāho’”ti?
segments.dn25:24.6: Atha kho bhagavā udumbarikāya paribbājakārāme sīhanādaṃ naditvā vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā gijjhakūṭe pabbate paccupaṭṭhāsi [paccuṭṭhāsi (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.dn25:24.7: Sandhāno pana gahapati tāvadeva rājagahaṃ pāvisīti.

lines: Ayaṃ pana mahānubhāvo parivāretvā vicarantānaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ aggapuriso anāgāmī bhagavatā mahāparisamajjhe evaṃ saṃvaṇṇito –
“Chahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato sandhāno gahapati tathāgate niṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme iriyati.
Buddhe aveccappasādena dhamme aveccappasādena saṅghe aveccappasādena ariyena sīlena ariyena ñāṇena ariyāya vimuttiyā.
Imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahi aṅgehi samannāgato sandhāno gahapati tathāgate niṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme iriyatī”ti (a. ni. 6.120-139).

So pātoyeva uposathaṅgāni adhiṭṭhāya pubbaṇhasamaye buddhappamukhassa saṅghassa dānaṃ datvā bhikkhūsu vihāraṃ gatesu ghare khuddakamahallakānaṃ dārakānaṃ saddena ubbāḷho satthu santike “dhammaṃ sossāmī”ti nikkhanto.
Tattha divā divassāti divasassa divā nāma majjhanhātikkamo, tasmiṃ divasassāpi divābhūte atikkantamatte majjhanhike nikkhamīti attho.
Paṭisallīnoti tato tato rūpādigocarato cittaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā nilīno jhānaratisevanāvasena ekībhāvaṃ gato.
Ye ca āvajjato manasikaroto cittaṃ vinīvaraṇaṃ hoti unnamati vaḍḍhati. 50.
Ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataroti ayaṃ tesaṃ abbhantaro eko sāvako, bhagavato kira sāvakā gihianāgāminoyeva pañcasatā rājagahe paṭivasanti.
Yesaṃ ekekassa pañca pañca upāsakasatāni parivārā, te sandhāya “ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro”ti āha.
Etadavocāti āgacchanto antarāmaggeyeva tesaṃ kathāya sutattā etaṃ aññathā kho imetiādivacanaṃ avoca.
Tattha aññatitthiyāti dassanenapi ākappenapi kuttenapi ācārenapi vihārenapi iriyāpathenapi aññe titthiyāti aññatitthiyā.
Saṅgamma samāgammāti saṅgantvā samāgantvā rāsi hutvā nisinnaṭṭhāne.
Iti sandhāno gahapati “aho mama satthā yo evarūpāni senāsanāni paṭisevatī”ti añjaliṃ paggayha uttamaṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapetvā imaṃ udānaṃ udānento nisīdi. 53.
Evaṃ vutteti evaṃ sandhānena gahapatinā udānaṃ udānentena vutte.

Nigrodho paribbājako ayaṃ gahapati mama santike nisinnopi attano satthāraṃyeva thometi ukkaṃsati, amhe pana atthītipi na maññati, etasmiṃ uppannakopaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa upari pātessāmīti sandhānaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca.
Kena samaṇo gotamo saddhiṃ sallapatīti kena kāraṇena kena puggalena saddhiṃ samaṇo gotamo sallapati vadati bhāsati.

“yadi kiñci sallāpakāraṇaṃ bhaveyya, yadi vā koci samaṇassa gotamassa santikaṃ sallāpatthiko gaccheyya, sallapeyya, na pana kāraṇaṃ atthi, na tassa santikaṃ koci gacchati, svāyaṃ kena samaṇo gotamo saddhiṃ sallapati, asallapanto kathaṃ unnādī bhavissatī”ti.
Suññāgārahatāti suññāgāresu naṭṭhā, samaṇena hi gotamena bodhimūle appamattikā paññā adhigatā, sāpissa suññāgāresu ekakassa nisīdato naṭṭhā.
Yadi pana mayaṃ viya gaṇasaṅgaṇikaṃ katvā nisīdeyya, nāssa paññā nasseyyāti dasseti.
Antamantānevāti koci maṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyāti pañhābhīto antamantāneva pantasenāsanāni sevati.
Sā kira pariyantacārinī hoti, antamantāneva sevati.
Sā kira kāṇakkhibhāvena vanantābhimukhīpi na sakkoti bhavituṃ.
Yasmā pattena vā sākhāya vā kaṇṭakena vā pahārassa bhāyati.
Yasmā siṅgena vā kaṇṇena vā vālena vā pahārassa bhāyati.
Pūritaghaṭo hi ito cito ca parivattetvā na suvinandhanīyo hoti.
Rittako yathāruci parivattetvā sakkā hoti vinandhituṃ, evameva hatapaññatāya rittakumbhisadisaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādavinandhanena samantā vinandhissāmāti vadati.

Iti paribbājako satthu suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ apassanto dasabalassa parammukhā attano balaṃ dīpento asambhinnaṃ khattiyakumāraṃ jātiyā ghaṭṭayanto caṇḍālaputto viya asambhinnakesarasīhaṃ migarājānaṃ thāmena ghaṭṭento jarasiṅgālo viya ca nānappakāraṃ tucchagajjitaṃ gajji.
Upāsakopi cintesi “ayaṃ paribbājako ati viya gajjati, avīciphusanatthāya pādaṃ, bhavaggaggahaṇatthāya hatthaṃ pasārayanto viya niratthakaṃ vāyamati.
Sace me satthā imaṃ ṭhānamāgaccheyya, imassa paribbājakassa yāva bhavaggā ussitaṃ mānaddhajaṃ ṭhānasova opāteyyā”ti. 54.
Sumāgadhāyāti sumāgadhā nāma pokkharaṇī, yassā tīre nisinno aññataro puriso padumanāḷantarehi asurabhavanaṃ pavisantaṃ asurasenaṃ addasa.
Moranivāpoti nivāpo vuccati bhattaṃ, yattha morānaṃ abhayena saddhiṃ nivāpo dinno, taṃ ṭhānanti attho.
“ko nāma so, bhante, dhammo yena bhagavatā sāvakā vinītā ajjhāsayādibrahmacariyabhūtaṃ ariyamaggaṃ pūretvā arahattādhigamavasena assāsapattā paṭijānantī”ti.
Vippakatāti mamāgamanapaccayā aniṭṭhitā, va hutvā ṭhitā, kathehi, ahametaṃ niṭṭhapetvā matthakaṃ pāpetvā dassemīti sabbaññupavāraṇaṃ pavāresi. 56.

Dujjānaṃ khoti bhagavā paribbājakassa vacanaṃ sutvā “ayaṃ paribbājako mayā sāvakānaṃ desetabbaṃ dhammaṃ tehi pūretabbaṃ paṭipattiṃ pucchati, sacassāhaṃ āditova taṃ kathessāmi, kathitampi naṃ na jānissati, ayaṃ pana vīriyena pāpajigucchanavādo, handāhaṃ etasseva visaye pañhaṃ pucchāpetvā puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ laddhiyā niratthakabhāvaṃ dassemi.
Atha pacchā imaṃ pañhaṃ byākarissāmī”ti cintetvā dujjānaṃ kho etantiādimāha.
“samaṇo gotamo ekaṃ pañhampi na katheti, sallāpakathāpissa atibahukā natthi, ime pana ādito paṭṭhāya samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ anuvattanti ceva pasaṃsanti ca, handāhaṃ ime nissadde katvā sayaṃ kathemī”ti.
“Tapojigucchavādā”tiādīsu tapojigucchaṃ vadāma, manasāpi tameva sārato gahetvā vicarāma, kāyenapimhā tameva allīnā, nānappakārakaṃ attakilamathānuyogamanuyuttā viharāmāti attho.
Tapaṃ samādiyatīti acelakabhāvādikaṃ tapaṃ sammā ādiyati, daḷhaṃ gaṇhāti.
Attamano hotīti ko añño mayā sadiso imasmiṃ tape atthīti tuṭṭhamano hoti.
Paripuṇṇasaṅkappoti alamettāvatāti evaṃ pariyositasaṅkappo, idañca titthiyānaṃ vasena āgataṃ.
Ekacco hi dhutaṅgaṃ samādiyati, so teneva dhutaṅgena ko añño mayā sadiso dhutaṅgadharoti attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo.
Tapassino upakkileso hotīti duvidhassāpetassa tapassino ayaṃ upakkileso hoti.
Attānukkaṃsetīti “ko mayā sadiso atthī”ti attānaṃ ukkaṃsati ukkhipati.
Paraṃ vambhetīti “ayaṃ na mādiso”ti paraṃ saṃhāreti avakkhipati.
Sāsane pabbajitopi dhutaṅgasuddhiko hoti, na kammaṭṭhānasuddhiko.
Lābhasakkārasilokanti ettha cattāro paccayā labbhantīti lābhā, teyeva suṭṭhu katvā paṭisaṅkharitvā laddhā sakkāro, vaṇṇabhaṇanaṃ siloko.
Abhinibbattetīti acelakādibhāvaṃ terasadhutaṅgasamādānaṃ vā nissāya mahālābho uppajjati, tasmā “abhinibbattetī”ti vutto.
Sesamettha purimavāranayeneva duvidhassāpi tapassino vasena veditabbaṃ. 60.
Vodāsaṃ āpajjatīti dvebhāgaṃ āpajjati, dve bhāge karoti.
Tassa evaṃ hoti “idāni evarūpaṃ kadā labhissāma, sace jāneyyāma, pātova khīrabhattaṃ na bhuñjeyyāma, kiṃ mayā sakkā kātuṃ, gaccha bho, tvameva bhuñjā”ti jīvitaṃ pariccajanto viya sāpekkho pajahati.
Ajjhāpannoti āmise atilaggo, “bhuñjissatha, āvuso”ti dhammanimantanamattampi akatvā mahante mahante kabaḷe karoti.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti “asanivicakkaṃ imassa dantakūṭaṃ mūlabījādīsu na kiñci na saṃbhuñjati.
Atha ca pana naṃ samaṇappavādena samaṇoti sañjānantī”ti.

Bhikkhuvasena panettha ayaṃ yojanā, attanā dhutaṅgadharo hoti, so aññaṃ evaṃ apasādeti “kiṃ samaṇā nāma ime samaṇamhāti vadanti, dhutaṅgamattampi natthi, uddesabhattādīni pariyesantā paccayabāhullikā vicarantī”ti.
Yattha te passanti, tattha ṭhito vaggulivataṃ carati, pañcātapaṃ tappati, ekapādena tiṭṭhati, sūriyaṃ namassati.

Sāsane pabbajitopi samādinnadhutaṅgo sabbarattiṃ sayitvā manussānaṃ cakkhupathe tapaṃ karoti, mahāsāyanheyeva cīvarakuṭiṃ karoti, sūriye uggate paṭisaṃharati, manussānaṃ āgatabhāvaṃ ñatvā ghaṇḍiṃ paharitvā cīvaraṃ matthake ṭhapetvā caṅkamaṃ otarati, sammuñjaniṃ gahetvā vihāraṅgaṇaṃ sammajjati.
Attānanti attano guṇaṃ adassayamānoti ettha a-kāro nipātamattaṃ, dassayamānoti attho.
Idampi me tapasminti idampi kammaṃ mameva tapasmiṃ, paccatte vā bhummaṃ, idampi mama tapoti attho.
So hi asukasmiṃ ṭhāne acelako atthi muttācārotiādīni sutvā amhākaṃ esa tapo, amhākaṃ so antevāsikotiādīni bhaṇati.
Asukasmiṃ vā pana ṭhāne paṃsukūliko bhikkhu atthītiādīni sutvā amhākaṃ esa tapo, amhākaṃ so antevāsikotiādīni bhaṇati.
Paṭicchannaṃ sevatīti yathā aññe na jānanti, evaṃ sevati.
Akkhamamānaṃ āha khamatīti aruccamānaṃyeva ruccati meti vadati.
Attanā kataṃ atimahantampi vajjaṃ appamattakaṃ katvā paññapeti, parena kataṃ dukkaṭamattaṃ vītikkamampi pārājikasadisaṃ katvā dasseti.
Kodhano hoti upanāhīti kujjhanalakkhaṇena kodhena, veraappaṭinissaggalakkhaṇena upanāhena ca samannāgato.
Makkhī hoti paḷāsīti paraguṇamakkhanalakkhaṇena makkhena, yugaggāhalakkhaṇena paḷāsena ca samannāgato.
Issukī hoti maccharīti parasakkārādīsu usūyanalakkhaṇāya issāya, āvāsakulalābhavaṇṇadhammesu maccharāyanalakkhaṇena pañcavidhamaccherena ca samannāgato hoti.
Saṭho hoti māyāvīti kerāṭikalakkhaṇena sāṭheyyena, katappaṭicchādanalakkhaṇāya māyāya ca samannāgato hoti.
Thaddho hoti atimānīti nissinehanikkaruṇathaddhalakkhaṇena thambhena, atikkamitvā maññanalakkhaṇena atimānena ca samannāgato hoti.
Antaggāhikāyāti sāyeva diṭṭhi ucchedantassa gahitattā “antaggāhikā”ti vuccati, tāya samannāgatoti attho.
Sandiṭṭhiparāmāsītiādīsu sayaṃ diṭṭhi sandiṭṭhi, sandiṭṭhimeva parāmasati gahetvā vadatīti sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī.
Ādhānaṃ vuccati daḷhaṃ suṭṭhu ṭhapitaṃ, tathā katvā gaṇhātīti ādhānaggāhī.
Ariṭṭho viya na sakkā hoti paṭinissajjāpetunti duppaṭinissaggī.

Idha, nigrodha, tapassīti evaṃ bhagavā aññatitthiyehi gahitaladdhiṃ tesaṃ rakkhitaṃ tapaṃ sabbameva saṃkiliṭṭhanti upakkilesapāḷiṃ dassetvā idāni parisuddhapāḷidassanatthaṃ desanamārabhanto idha, nigrodhātiādimāha.
Sabbavāresu ca lūkhatapassino ceva dhutaṅgadharassa ca vasena yojanā veditabbā.

Evaṃ so tasmiṃ ṭhāne parisuddho hotīti evaṃ so tena na attamanatā na paripuṇṇasaṅkappabhāvasaṅkhātena kāraṇena parisuddho nirupakkileso hoti, uttari vāyamamāno kammaṭṭhānasuddhiko hutvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti.
Addhā kho, bhanteti bhante evaṃ sante ekaṃseneva vīriyena pāpajigucchanavādo parisuddho hotīti anujānāti.
Ito parañca aggabhāvaṃ vā sārabhāvaṃ vā ajānanto aggappattā sārappattā cāti āha.
Athassa bhagavā sārappattabhāvaṃ paṭisedhento na kho nigrodhātiādimāha.
Papaṭikappattā hotīti sāravato rukkhassa sāraṃ phegguṃ tacañca atikkamma bahipapaṭikasadisā hotīti dasseti.
Aggaṃ pāpetūti desanāvasena aggaṃ pāpetvā desetu, sāraṃ pāpetvā desetūti dasabalaṃ yācati.
Na bhāvitamāsīsatīti bhāvitaṃ nāma tesaṃ saññāya pañca kāmaguṇā, te na āsīsati na sevatīti attho.
Aduṃ cassa hotīti etañcassa idāni vuccamānaṃ “so abhiharatī”tiādilakkhaṇaṃ.
Tattha so abhiharatīti so taṃ sīlaṃ abhiharati, uparūpari vaḍḍheti.
Sīlaṃ me paripuṇṇaṃ, tapo āraddho, alamettāvatāti na vīriyaṃ vissajjeti.
Sīlato uttari visesādhigamatthāya vīriyaṃ karotiyeva, evaṃ karonto so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati.
Phegguppattāti tacato abbhantaraṃ phegguṃ pattā, pheggusadisā hotīti attho. 74.
“Ettāvatā, kho nigrodha, tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā cā”ti idaṃ bhagavā titthiyānaṃ vasenāha.
Iti bhagavatā attano sāsanaṃ onatavinataphalabhārabharitarukkhūpamāya upamitaṃ.
So desanākusalatāya tato tacasārasampattito mama sāsanaṃ uttaritarañceva paṇītatarañca, taṃ tuvaṃ kadā jānissasīti attanodesanāya visesabhāvaṃ dassetuṃ “iti kho nigrodhā”ti desanaṃ ārabhi.
Te paribbājakāti te tassa parivārā tiṃsasatasaṅkhyā paribbājakā.
Ettha mayaṃ anassāmāti ettha acelakapāḷiādīsu, idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti “amhākaṃ acelakapāḷimattampi natthi, kuto parisuddhapāḷi.
Ito bhiyyo uttaritaranti ito dibbacakkhuñāṇādhigamato bhiyyo aññaṃ uttaritaraṃ visesādhigamaṃ mayaṃ sutivasenāpi na jānāmāti vadanti.

Atha nigrodhaṃ paribbājakanti evaṃ kirassa ahosi “ime paribbājakā idāni bhagavato bhāsitaṃ sussūsanti, iminā ca nigrodhena bhagavato parammukhā kakkhaḷaṃ durāsadavacanaṃ vuttaṃ, idāni ayampi sotukāmo jāto, kālo dāni me imassa mānaddhajaṃ nipātetvā bhagavato sāsanaṃ ukkhipitu”nti.
Aparampissa ahosi “ayaṃ mayi akathente satthāraṃ na khamāpessati, tadassa anāgate ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattissati, mayā pana kathite khamāpessati, tadassa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
Aparisāvacaraṃ pana naṃ karothāti ettha panāti nipāto, atha naṃ aparisāvacaraṃ karothāti attho.
“Aparisāvacareta”ntipi pāṭho, aparisāvacaraṃ vā etaṃ karotha, gokāṇādīnaṃ vā aññataranti attho.
Gokāṇanti etthāpi gokāṇaṃ pariyantacāriniṃ viya karothāti attho.
Buddho so bhagavā bodhāyāti sayaṃ buddho sattānampi catusaccabodhatthāya dhammaṃ deseti.
Santoti rāgasantatāya santo, dosamohasantatāya sabba akusalasabbābhisaṅkhārasantatāya santo.
Ahamanusāsāmīti ahaṃ tādisaṃ puggalaṃ anusāsāmi, dhammaṃ assa desemi.
